pattern: Field list in the authoring-forms shape. pack_author.py does not parse this file.
meaning: The judgment Prime returns. Compute bindings are not fields of this file.

owners.intelligence: finding, reasons, operation, disposition, terminals, next action, semantic conflict, findings, sections, holds, answers, passes, gaps
owners.compute: intake id, review id, digests, custody mode, destination

fields.name: finding
fields.meaning: Prime's finding about the measured return.

fields.name: reasons
fields.meaning: Evidence-based reasons. An explicit empty list is a supplied empty account, not a default.

fields.name: operation
fields.meaning: continue, director-input, develop, or complete. Not a command.

fields.name: disposition
fields.meaning: accepted, held, or correction-required. Accepted is not Director consent.

fields.name: goal_terminal
fields.meaning: completed or open. Completed is allowed only with operation complete.

fields.name: next_action
fields.meaning: The next action Prime supplies. Compute does not invent one.

fields.name: semantic_conflict
fields.meaning: True, false, or null. Null is the legal unknown. Omission is a missing field, not false.

fields.name: design_fork
fields.meaning: Null, or an object with id and text.

fields.name: findings
fields.meaning: Each finding Prime is accounting. Disposition is answered, fixed, or elevated. None are dropped.

fields.name: sections
fields.meaning: The prime-review section object. Unknown section values stay null. tests_passed null is not passed.

fields.name: holds
fields.meaning: Director holds Prime is recording. An explicit empty list means none are supplied.

fields.name: answers
fields.meaning: Replies Prime supplies. A reply does not close a finding by itself.

fields.name: review_passes
fields.meaning: Linked review passes. Explicit empty is supplied. Two unresolved passes are not closed here.

fields.name: gaps
fields.meaning: Gaps Prime names. These are copied to the cycle unresolved list. They are not invented.
